m.english: Because the only real evidence they've got is the knife from your cabin.

target.text: Porque la única prueba real que tienen es la navaja de tu cabaña.

translation.text: Because the only real evidence they've got is the knife from your cabin.

m.english: Took a razor and started slicing through her skin.

target.text: Tomó una navaja y comenzó a cortar su piel.

m.english: But who do you think told them about the switchblade?

target.text: Pero ¿quién crees que les dijo de la navaja?

m.english: He sliced open his pocket with a razor, took his wallet.

target.text: Le abrió el bolsillo con una navaja... y tomó su cartera.

m.english: The weapon is a Spanish sword called a navaja.

target.text: El arma es una espada española conocida como navaja.

translation.text: The weapon is a Spanish sword called a navaja.

m.english: Now use your pocketknife to strip this cable.

target.text: Ahora usa tu navaja para despojar a este cable.

m.english: Good thing I had Cabe's pocket knife with me.

target.text: Qué bueno que tenía la navaja de Cabe en mi bolsillo.

m.english: He took out his penknife and opened the monster from inside.

target.text: Sacó su navaja... y rajó al monstruo, desde dentro.

target.text: Haz una navaja con tu cepillo de dientes .
